text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You want to know what kind of
performances I
put on to please my
fans?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In truth, I recently received an
invitation to a
fan gathering. It's a meet
and greet event with the
Yaeno Cheer
Brigade.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I wish to respond in kind and repay them
for their
continued and heartfelt
support, but no amount
of brain-racking
is yielding any ideas as to how I
can do
that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I heard that you often assist with the
planning of
fan meet and greets. I would
love to hear any
words of advice you
might have to share.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, in that case I've got you covered. I
know just
what you need.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Slurrrrp!

text_block_list.name: Oguri and Yaeno
text_block_list.text:
That hit the spot.
I-indeed... That hit...
the spot...

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You two inhaled those noodles! I
hope you
take that energy to the track
the next time you
race!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So what do you think? This is my secret

weapon—the "One Hundred Ramen
Bowlnanza"!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Y-yes, it's as if I was... at an actual
race...
Everyone was... so exci...ted...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yaeno? Are you oka—Yaeno?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo and Yaeno
text_block_list.text: BURNING ATTAAACK!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yesss! I knew you'd pull it off, Yaeno!
And you
nailed it even better than I
could've imagined!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I hope you'll allow me to use
these
moves as reference for—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Not yet!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...I realized something. My shout's just
nowhere
near as intense as yours. I've
gotta up the ante
and improve my battle
call, so please...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait for me! I swear, after my training,
I'll show
you something you'll never
forget!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...What?! But Bamboo! I cannot allow
you to go to
such extraordinary lengths!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O and Yaeno
text_block_list.text: BOOGIEEE FEVEEER! Ooh! Ooh!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
You're both so awesome! Boogie on and
keep on
keepin' on!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So, what do you think of the dance
moves
Maruzen taught me? Were they
far out or what?
And look! Everyone's
stoked to the max!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, y-yes... They do appear to be...
quite... Um.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Don't get embarrassed now! Set yourself
free!
Embrace the shimmer of the disco
ball, like me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will s-set myself free!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ramen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Yaeno, are you on your way to have
dinner
as well? Actually, I've just
finished a run myself,
so...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ramen... burning... fever...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yaeno?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so you've been struggling to decide
what sort
of performance to put on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Let's see. If that's your dilemma,
why not
take a step back and reassess
what it is that you
really ought to be
doing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Your fans are the ones you're trying to
make
happy, yes?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Yes, of course. They were the ones
who
organized the event, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In that case... are you certain you should be asking Oguri and the others about what makes their fans happy?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...What a shameful fool I am. It seems
that
somewhere along the way, I lost
sight of what
truly matters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the
academy, I
chance upon Yaeno Muteki
looking deep in
thought. Concerned, I
ask her whether
everything's all right.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure what to do for my meet and
greet... I
want to please my fans, but I
also want something
that shows who I
am.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No. This is an issue I must resolve myself.
I vow to
find a performance that is both
true to me and
impressive to my fans!
choice_data_list: 何か手伝えることはある？

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No. This is an issue I must resolve myself.
And I
will do everything in my power to
find the answer.
